Subject: FinReg discovery recap & next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps: 

- Key priorities you mentioned: PCI-adjacent audit readiness, reducing inference costs for rule-based scoring, and predictable SLAs for peak month processing.
- Our initial suggestion: Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) + prefix caching for your nightly batch window to cut unit costs.

Open action items we agreed on: 
1) I'll share a short SOW & estimated baseline pricing (attached).
2) Soojin — can you review the technical assumptions re: KV cache sizing and the proposed throughput target (500 concurrent streams)?
3) Jordan — if this looks directionally right, can we schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review the SOW and run a quick tech deep-dive?

Proposed times: Tue 4/6 10:00–10:30am PT or Wed 4/7 2:00–2:30pm PT — let me know what works.

Attaching: 20270401-FinReg-SOW-draft.pdf and call recording stub.

Thanks,
Marissa

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: FinReg discovery recap & next steps — quick internal alignment before recontacting

Team —

Jordan hasn't responded to the follow-up (see thread below). FinReg looks like a solid mid-market opportunity (FIN-4237) but likely needs the right technical/CS touch before we re-engage. Want to align on approach so we don't come off as noisy. High-level:

- Recap: discovery call 4/1, priorities = audit readiness + cost predictability. I sent SOW and two proposed times; no reply yet.
- Goal: get a 30-min follow-up to review SOW and confirm throughput targets.
- Ask from each of you:
  - Soojin — quick sanity check on KV cache sizing and whether we should propose an architecture diagram in the follow-up.
  - Monica — any red flags on onboarding / CS scope (implementation window, checkpoints) in the SOW draft?
  - Marcus / Lauren — any sensitivity around offering a one-time onboarding credit or accelerated SLA to help close? I want to avoid unapproved concessions.

My plan if we get approval: send a short, softened re-engagement note that reiterates value, offers two new time slots, and includes a one-pager architecture sketch if Soojin can sign off today. If we don't get responses internally, I can still do a light touch (one more bump) but would prefer an SE/CS presence if possible.

Timeline: I plan to recontact Jordan today late morning PT if I get thumbs-up by 10:30am.

Thanks — quick replies appreciated.
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fw: FinReg discovery recap & next steps — quick internal alignment before recontacting

Thanks for the ping — quick notes from my side:

- KV cache sizing: 500 concurrent streams seems high if their average seq len is 1–2k tokens; we should clarify their peak QPS and whether batch windows are staggered. I can draft a simple architecture diagram (prefix+shared cache nodes) and a short note on tradeoffs in ~45 minutes.
- Recommend we avoid offering onboarding credits right away. Instead, offer a time-limited implementation SLA (30-day accelerated onboarding) as a gesture; credits can be discussed by GTM/ops.
- I'm available to join the customer call Tues 4/13 10:00–11:00am PT if that helps.

If Marissa wants the architecture sketch, I'll drop it in this thread and attach it to the outreach.

— Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks Soojin. Monica / Marcus / Lauren, anything else before I recontact Jordan around 11:30am PT? I'll include the architecture sketch and offer the 30-day accelerated onboarding SLA as a limited-time ask.

If no objections by 11:20, I'll send a short re-engagement note phrased as: "Checking in — do you still plan to move forward this quarter? We'd love to share a short architecture sketch and a 30-day accelerated onboarding option if it helps with planning."

Thanks all —
Marissa
